1.title: Stage 1: Solution State (Target & Padlock Probe)
1.desc: Single-stranded target sequence (DNA/RNA) and linear Padlock Probe with 5'-phosphate and 3'-hydroxyl termini float independently in hybridization buffer.

2.title: Stage 2: Target Recognition & Hybridization
2.desc: Padlock probe arms recognize and anneal to contiguous target sites in an antiparallel orientation, looping the backbone and aligning termini into a nick junction.

3.title: Stage 3: Enzymatic Ligation & Topological Interlocking
3.desc: DNA Ligase or SplintR inspects the nick. If perfect base-pairing is detected with zero gap, it catalyzes phosphodiester bond synthesis to yield a covalently closed circle.

4.title: Stage 4: RCA Primer Annealing
4.desc: Sequence-specific RCA primer anneals to the complementary binding cassette on the circular padlock template, supplying the free 3'-OH terminus required for polymerase extension.

5.title: Stage 5: Continuous Phi29 Rolling Circle Amplification (RCA)
5.desc: Phi29 DNA Polymerase engages the primed template and initiates isothermal rolling synthesis, displacing downstream strands to generate long tandem concatemers.

6.title: Stage 6: Concatemer Hybridization & Fluorescence Detection
6.desc: Sequence-specific fluorescent detection probes anneal to repeating monomer cassettes along the concatemer, emitting measurable fluorescent signals.
